name: mc_get_context
description: Capture the player's current gaze anchor (lookTarget, camera basis right/up/forward, terrain heightmap, surrounding blocks, recentStructures). Do NOT call on turn 1—world snapshot is already provided.

playerName.description: Optional player name; defaults to active online player.

lockAnchor.description: If true, locks a fresh build anchor at the player's current gaze.

name: mc_build_batch
description: Queue ordered block placements using geometric primitives and custom block/pattern ops. Always put metadata (anchorId, coordMode, label, sortMode) BEFORE ops.

anchorId.description: Optional saved structure anchor id (e.g. 's1' or 'last') to target an existing build in its local coords.

coordMode.description: Default 'local': [right, up, forward] relative to locked gaze anchor or anchorId.

label.description: Short label for this build (e.g. 'Cozy Timber Cottage').

ops.description: Build ops (integer [r,u,f] coords; any op supports mirrorX:true (+optional mirrorCenter) and repeat:{axis:'r'|'u'|'f',count,step} or {offset:[dr,du,df],count}). Ops: box {type:'box',from,to,material|palette}, hollow_box {type:'hollow_box',from,to,thickness,floorMaterial,wallMaterial,roofMaterial}, pillar {type:'pillar',at,height,radius,material,capMaterial}, cylinder {type:'cylinder',center,radius,height,hollow,axis,material|palette}, dome {type:'dome',center,radius,height?,hollow,half:'upper'|'lower'|'full',material}, arch {type:'arch',from,to,height,thickness,material}, stairs_run {type:'stairs_run',from,to,width,material,railMaterial,autoHeadroom:true}, bridge {type:'bridge',from,to,width,sag,material,railMaterial}, spiral {type:'spiral',center,radius,height,turns,width,material}, ring {type:'ring',center,radius,innerRadius,thickness,axis,material}, scatter {type:'scatter',from,to,density,onlyAir,palette}, pattern {type:'pattern',plane:'floor'|'front'|'side',at,rows,key} (spaces and '.' skip), blocks {type:'blocks',items:[{pos,material}]} or {type:'blocks',positions,material}, clear {type:'clear',from,to}, move/shift/copy {type:'move'|'shift'|'copy',from,to,by:[dr,du,df],dy,structureId:'s1'|'last',copy:false,includeAir:false,clearFill:'air'}. Plugin auto-fixes doors (upper half + double hinges), beds (head half), tall flora, stair headroom, and water_cauldron.

commands.description: Optional 1.21.4 commands to validate & run immediately with this batch ({{REL r u f}} supported).

finish.description: Default true: complete build with finish shockwave & VFX. Set false for intermediate batches.

reply.description: Concise 1-2 sentence reply in the player's language to show in chat immediately upon queueing.

name: mc_function_pack
description: Deploy, replace, or remove a persistent Minecraft datapack. Functions named tick and load run automatically at the deployment anchor. Other functions can be called as mh_<id>:<path>.

anchorId.description: Optional saved structure anchor id (e.g. 's1' or 'last') to target an existing build in its local coords.

functions.description: Required for deploy. Map function paths to ordered mcfunction lines ({{REL r u f}} expanded).

name: mc_place_command_chain
description: Place and wire an Impulse/Repeating/Chain 1.21.4 command block chain with Brigadier validation, {{REL r u f}} macros, Always Active auto:1b, optional Command Core, and optional trigger.

anchorId.description: Optional saved structure anchor id (e.g. 's1' or 'last') to target an existing build in its local coords.

label.description: Label displayed above the Command Core.

auto.description: Always Active for block 0 (default true for repeating, false if triggered).

placement.description: 'core' glass Command Core pod; 'at' uses local/world coords; 'hidden' omits casing.

at.description: Optional [right, up, forward] coordinate when placement='at'.

commands.description: Ordered 1.21.4 commands (no leading slash; supports {{REL r u f}}).

trigger.description: Optional interactive trigger placed inside the arena.

name: mc_exec_commands
description: Execute one-off Minecraft 1.21.4 server commands immediately (scoreboard, gamerules, summon, give, time, title) with {{REL r u f}} macro expansion and Brigadier validation.

anchorId.description: Optional saved structure anchor id (e.g. 's1' or 'last') to target an existing build in its local coords.

commands.description: Minecraft 1.21.4 commands to validate and run immediately as console.

at.description: Local [right, up, forward] to sample immediately after these commands.

afterMs.description: Sample the same block again after this many milliseconds.

observe.description: For testing timed mechanics, returns the two observed block states and actual sample times in one call.

name: mc_inspect_world
description: Scan blocks, command blocks, and nearby entities in a local [right, up, forward] bounding box to inspect or modify an existing build.

anchorId.description: Optional saved structure anchor id (e.g. 's1' or 'last') to target an existing build in its local coords.

view.description: Exact material projection (up to 96x96). Dot is air, ? is overflow. Front/side rows descend; top rows advance forward.

sampleCoords.description: Specific local blocks to read with their full block states.

name: mc_fx
description: Trigger finish shockwave, ambient illumination particle aura, or cinematic effects (finish, shockwave, firework, title, time_night, time_sunset, time_day, lightning, illumination, clear_illumination).

anchorId.description: Optional saved structure anchor id (e.g. 's1' or 'last') to target an existing build in its local coords.

from.description: Local [r, u, f] min corner for illumination region.

to.description: Local [r, u, f] max corner for illumination region.

name: mc_take_photo
description: Capture a live screenshot of the Minecraft client window (or top-down voxel map fallback if headless).

anchorId.description: Optional saved structure anchor id (e.g. 's1' or 'last') to target an existing build in its local coords.

angle.description: Camera viewpoint; 'current' shoots from player's view, others temporarily move camera and restore immediately after.

cameraAt.description: Local [r, u, f] camera position when angle='custom'.

lookAt.description: Local [r, u, f] target point to aim camera at (default [0, 2, 8]).

distance.description: Distance from build for orbit/front angles (default 16).

waitMs.description: Render settle delay in ms after moving camera (default 350).

name: mc_review
description: Decide how carefully the finished build is checked, from what the player said. Call it only when the player's words say something about checking: e.g. 'ちゃんと確認して' / '念入りに' / 'しっかり見直して' (strict or max), 'さっと' / '確認はいらない' (light or off), or when they ask to check/fix up a build that already exists without asking for a new one ('点検して', '見直して'). Do not call it otherwise: the server default applies. The check runs after your turn ends; do not start it yourself.

level.description: off = no check, light = 1 round, normal = up to 3, strict = up to 5 with a strict checklist, max = as long as the budget allows.

anchorId.description: Build to check when no build was made this turn (e.g. 's1' or 'last'). Default 'last'.
